data.one_liner: A Result type representing success or failure in Dart
data.what_it_does: It provides a type that can hold either a success value or a failure value, allowing you to handle outcomes without throwing exceptions. The API supports mapping, flatMapping, and unwrapping with defaults.
use_when: Handling async operation results without exceptions
Chaining multiple operations that may fail
Providing a functional style error handling in pure Dart
avoid_when: When you prefer traditional try/catch exception handling
When you need a full-featured state management solution
weaknesses: No built-in async/await integration beyond Result type
Limited to single value, not collections or streams
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import package: import 'package:result_type/result_type.dart';
